text: What breaks will grow again; what is lost will be replaced.
Whoever rests, rusts.
If at first you don't succeed, try, try again.
Strike while the iron is hot.
Honesty is the best policy.
A gem cannot be polished without friction, nor a person perfected without trials.
Diligence is the root of cleverness.
The higher the clouds, the finer the weather.
An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
Live a century, learn a century.
Tomorrow is another day.
Hold a true friend with both hands.
The person who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
He who asks is a fool for five minutes; he who does not ask remains a fool forever.
May the road rise to meet you, and the wind be always at your back.
Flies don't enter a closed mouth.
Vision without action is a daydream; action without vision is a nightmare.
Knowledge is like a garden: if it is not cultivated, it cannot be harvested.

Learning is a treasure that will follow its owner everywhere.
To get lost is to learn the way.
Whoever lives will see.
Practice makes the master.
One tree cannot make a hill; three trees together make a mountain.
Failure is the foundation of success.
Small boats should keep near shore.

Clear moon, frost soon.
Make haste slowly.

Dumplings rather than flowers.

Measure seven times, cut once.
Good things come in small packages.
An old friend is better than two new ones.
Even a sheet of paper is lighter when two people lift it.
Laughter is the best medicine.

Wonder is the beginning of wisdom.
Better safe than sorry.
No matter how hot your anger is, it cannot cook yams.
One finger cannot crush a louse.

Everything in its own time.
At the table, no one grows old.

Every bird flies with its own wings.
Praise the young and they will blossom.
A good beginning makes a good ending.
Our life is frittered away by detail. Simplify, simplify.
Throw a lucky person into the sea and they will come up with a fish in their mouth.

Instruction in youth is like engraving in stone.
He who learns, teaches.
Little by little, the bird builds its nest.
Seize the day.
Very little is needed to make a happy life.
However long the night, the dawn will break.
Better bend than break.
Who finds a friend finds a treasure.

Do not look where you fell, but where you slipped.
A stitch in time saves nine.

A dragon can rise from a small stream.
Rain does not fall on one roof alone.
Rome wasn't built in a day.
We plan, and the heavens laugh.
Patience is a virtue.
Every cloud has a silver lining.
Words have no wings, yet they fly a thousand miles.
All's well that ends well.
Even monkeys fall from trees.
When the music changes, so does the dance.

Better late than never.

Variety is the spice of life.

Practice makes perfect.
All beginnings are hard.
Time flies.
Whoever seeks, finds.

Even dust, piled up, becomes a mountain.

This too shall pass.
After clouds, sunshine.

Little by little fills the measure.
It's an ill wind that blows nobody any good.
Where there's a will, there's a way.
There's no place like home.
Talk does not cook rice.
A roaring lion kills no game.

Many hands make light work.

Home is where the heart is.

The beginning is half of everything.

Waste not, want not.

Wherever you live becomes your capital.

Each day provides its own gifts.

One good turn deserves another.
The morning is wiser than the evening.
A good neighbour is better than a distant relative.
Worry gives a small thing a big shadow.
Bend the bamboo while it is still a shoot.

The afternoon knows what the morning never suspected.
Red sky at night, sailor's delight.
Heavy loads are shouldered together; light ones are carried together.
Actions speak louder than words.
The world is one family.
Two people shorten the road.
Haste makes waste.
Absence makes the heart grow fonder.

Where there is patience, there is stew.
When you drink water, remember its source.
Time and tide wait for no one.
Two heads are better than one.

No day without a line.
Little by little, one goes far.
After the rain, good weather.
The morning hour has gold in its mouth.
Don't count your chickens before they hatch.
Sticks in a bundle are unbreakable.
The proof of the pudding is in the eating.
A good conscience is a soft pillow.
Little by little, over time, it becomes a hill.

An inch of time is an inch of gold.
One generation plants the trees; another gets the shade.
Necessity is the mother of invention.
Good things come to those who wait.
He who cannot dance says the yard is stony.
Hard work conquers all.
A small leak will sink a great ship.
Ask the experienced rather than the learned.
God helps those who rise early.
Birds of a feather flock together.
Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth his friend.
The sun shines on both sides of the hedge.
Whoever has health has hope, and whoever has hope has everything.
Drop by drop, the pot is filled.
Between saying and doing lies the sea.
Turn misfortune into a blessing.
A sunshiny shower won't last half an hour.
We must cultivate our garden.
Without work, there are no cakes.
The habit does not make the monk.
Love conquers all.
Not every cloud brings rain.

Truth alone triumphs.

Every path has its puddle.

Time flies like an arrow.
To bad weather, a good face.
Drop by drop, a river is made.
Hardship eases with habit.
Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise.

Least said, soonest mended.
One swallow does not make a summer.

Nothing in excess.

Easy does it.
Every little helps.
The early bird catches the worm.
A soft answer turneth away wrath.
No one tests the depth of a river with both feet.
Every dog has its day.
Laziness travels so slowly that poverty soon overtakes it.

He who sleeps catches no fish.
Time spent laughing is time spent with the gods.
Don't judge a book by its cover.
If you are in a hurry, take the long way round.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
Good agreements make good friends.
Be not afraid of growing slowly, be afraid only of standing still.

Like a frog under a coconut shell.
Don't put off till tomorrow what you can do today.
Examine what is said, not who is speaking.
United we stand, divided we fall.
Fortune favours the brave.
However far you have gone down the wrong road, turn back.
Those who wish to sing always find a song.
When the water rises, fish eat ants; when it falls, ants eat fish.
Make hay while the sun shines.
The day you decide to do it is your lucky day.
Early to bed and early to rise makes a man healthy, wealthy and wise.
Do good, and don't look to whom.
Tell me who you walk with, and I'll tell you who you are.
The grass is always greener on the other side.
Seeing once is better than hearing a hundred times.
